components.description: A file entry surface with drag feedback, keyboard access, and a separate browse action.

components.description: A button with primary text and a second line that explains the action.

components.description: A spectrum surface for picking a color, with RGB, hex, and optional alpha editing.

components.description: A drop-down list for selecting one item from a set of options.

components.description: Lets people view, set, or clear star ratings.

components.description: Lets people select a value from a range by dragging a handle along a track.

components.description: Hosts resizable panes separated by draggable handles.

components.title: TreeView
components.description: A control that presents hierarchical data with expandable nodes.

components.title: CalendarView
components.description: A calendar surface for browsing months and selecting dates.

components.title: DatePicker
components.description: A spinning-field picker for choosing a day, month, and year.

components.title: TimePicker
components.description: A spinning-field picker for choosing a time of day.

components.description: A modal dialog with title, content, and up to three commit buttons.

components.description: A modal window surface that hosts arbitrary content above the app.

components.description: A floating surface positioned over app content.

components.description: An anchored tip that draws attention to a feature without blocking interaction.

components.description: A standalone teaching tip in its own window that points a tail at a target and glides between them.

components.description: Coordinates a vertical group of expandable sections with single or multiple expansion.

components.description: A rounded, token-backed surface for grouping related content.

components.description: A DPI-aligned horizontal or vertical separator with optional insets.

components.title: Expander
components.description: A disclosure surface that reveals caller-supplied content with an optional animation.

components.description: A list of commands shown in a transient surface.

components.description: A responsive command strip with primary and overflow actions.

components.title: CommandBarFlyout

components.title: NavigationView
components.description: An adaptive left pane plus content area for top-level navigation.

components.description: Header-based navigation between peer views with an animated indicator.

components.title: SelectorBar
components.description: A row of selectable items for switching between views.

components.title: TabView
components.description: A control that hosts multiple pages of content behind a tab strip.

components.title: AnnotatedScrollBar
components.description: A scrollbar with labels that make long content easier to navigate.

components.title: PipsPager
components.description: Dot-style pagination for moving through a small set of pages.

components.title: ScrollBar
components.description: A Fluent-styled scrollbar with hover expansion.

components.title: ScrollView
components.description: A scrollable viewport with Fluent scrollbars and optional zoom.

components.title: Avatar

components.title: InfoBadge
components.description: A small badge that shows counts, icons, or attention dots.

components.title: InfoBar
components.description: An inline bar for status messages with severity and optional actions.

components.description: Shows determinate or indeterminate progress along a line.

components.title: ProgressRing
components.description: Shows determinate or indeterminate progress around a ring.

components.description: Cover a content area during startup, report progress, and dismiss when ready.

components.title: Shimmer
components.description: Shows a skeleton placeholder while content is loading.

components.title: Toast
components.description: Shows a brief same-window notification without interrupting the current task.

components.title: ToolTip
components.description: A popup label that shows extra information about a control on hover.

components.title: AutoSuggestBox
components.description: A text box that suggests matching items while people type.

components.title: Label
components.description: Static text rendered with Fluent typography roles and elision.

components.title: LineEdit
components.description: A single-line text box with Fluent styling and a clear button.

components.title: NumberBox
components.description: A numeric input with spin buttons and inline expression support.

components.title: PasswordBox
components.description: A text box that conceals input with an optional reveal button.

components.title: TextEdit
components.description: A multi-line text surface for longer-form input.

components.title: TitleBar
components.description: A custom window title bar with drag regions and themed chrome.

components.title: Window
components.description: A Fluent top-level window with custom chrome and theming.

components.description: A theme-aware widget that renders bundled Fluent icon glyphs at optical sizes.
